theorems.name: Submission.exists_smooth_mean_value_kernel
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ ρ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ρ ∧ (∀ z : Rn n, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) ∧ ∀ (h : Rn n → ℝ) (x₀ : Rn n) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → ContDiff ℝ 2 h → (∀ y ∈ closedBall x₀ t, Laplacian.laplacian h y = 0) → ∫ y, t⁻¹ ^ n * ρ (t⁻¹ • y) * h (x₀ - y) = h x₀
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
